titulo_fr: Comparer des sources : Observer les formes
intro: It contrasts data that match and differ in two sources on the same event. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It contrasts data that match and differ in two sources on the same event. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: Distinguish source, date and scope; two texts can use different figures because they measure different periods. In this fragment, «enquête» means «survey».

frases.fr: Une enquête publiée en juin donne 55 %, mais elle interroge uniquement les résidents du centre.
frases.es: Una encuesta publicada en junio da un 55 %, pero solo pregunta a los residentes del centro.
frases.en: A survey published in June is 55%, but only asks the residents of the centre.

frases.fr: Les deux textes confirment que la fréquentation augmente depuis l'ouverture de la nouvelle aire de jeux.
frases.es: Ambos textos confirman que las visitas aumentan desde que se abrió la nueva zona de juegos.
frases.en: Both texts confirm that the visits have increased since the new game area was opened.
